js: (async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 100 && !state.results.length; i++) await new Promise((res) => setTimeout(res, 100)); const w = (id) => nameWords({ id }).map((x) => x.w + (x.hide ? '*' : '')).join(','); const cases = { 'huihui-ai/Qwen3-8B-abliterated': 'abliterated*', 'p-e-w/gemma-3-270m-it-heretic': 'Heretic*', 'x/Llama-3-8B-Uncensored': 'uncensored*', 'x/Foo-12B-Derestricted': 'derestricted*', 'x/Bar-7B-NSFW': 'NSFW*', 'cognitivecomputations/dolphin-2.9-llama3-8b': 'Dolphin', 'x/Mistral-7B-RP': 'role-play', 'Qwen/Qwen3-8B-Base': 'base', 'google-bert/bert-base-uncased': '', 'deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B': 'distill', 'x/Qwen-7B-slerp': 'merge', 'x/Sharpe-7B-Instruct': '', 'Qwen/Qwen3-14B': '' }; const bad = Object.entries(cases).filter(([id, want]) => w(id) !== want).map(([id, want]) => id + ' gave "' + w(id) + '" not "' + want + '"'); const counts = { abliterated: 0, heretic: 0, hide: 0 }; for (const r of state.results) { const ws = nameWords(r.m); if (ws.some((x) => x.w === 'abliterated')) counts.abliterated++; if (ws.some((x) => x.w === 'Heretic')) counts.heretic++; if (ws.some((x) => x.hide)) counts.hide++; } return (bad.length ? 'FAIL | ' + bad.join(' ; ') : 'OK') + ' | analysed rows with the words: ' + JSON.stringify(counts); })()

log: Filter: the box 'Hide uncensored versions' hides those names, shows a chip, and the chip's x and Defaults turn it off; it is kept in the prefs
js: (async () => { resetFilters(); state.f.pop = false; $('fPop').checked = false; renderList(); const before = state.visible.length, hideBefore = state.visible.filter((r) => nameWords(r.m).some((x) => x.hide)).length; $('fUnc').click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); const after = state.visible.length, left = state.visible.filter((r) => nameWords(r.m).some((x) => x.hide)).length; const chip = [...document.querySelectorAll('#activeFilters [data-unfilter]')].find((b) => b.dataset.unfilter === 'f:unc'); const chipText = chip ? chip.textContent.trim() : '-'; savePrefs(); const saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('tt-prefs') || '{}').f || {}; if (chip) chip.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); const offAgain = !state.f.unc && !$('fUnc').checked && state.visible.length === before; $('fUnc').click(); resetFilters(); renderList(); const reset = !state.f.unc && !$('fUnc').checked; const ok = state.f.pop === true && hideBefore > 0 && before - after === hideBefore && left === 0 && /Uncensored hidden/.test(chipText) && saved.unc === true && offAgain && reset; return (ok ? 'OK' : 'FAIL') + ' | shown ' + before + ' -> ' + after + ' (hidden by name: ' + hideBefore + ', left: ' + left + ') | chip: ' + chipText + ' | saved: ' + saved.unc + ' | chip x: ' + offAgain + ' | reset: ' + reset; })()

log: Overview: an abliterated model shows 'Name says abliterated' with a Help link; Qwen3-14B shows no such line
js: (async () => { const waitPlan = async (id) => { for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) { const d = state.detail.get(detailKey(id)); if (d && d.plan) return d; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); } return null; }; showModel('Qwen/Qwen3-14B', 'overview'); await waitPlan('Qwen/Qwen3-14B'); renderDetail(); const plainNone = !document.querySelector('#detail .ov-name'); const cand = state.results.filter((r) => nameWords(r.m).some((x) => x.w === 'abliterated')).sort((a, b) => b.m.downloads - a.m.downloads)[0]; if (!cand) return 'FAIL | no abliterated model analysed'; window.__nameId = cand.m.id; showModel(cand.m.id, 'overview'); await waitPlan(cand.m.id); renderDetail(); const line = document.querySelector('#detail .ov-name'); const txt = line ? line.innerText.replace(/\s+/g, ' ') : ''; const btn = line && line.querySelector('[data-helpgo="help-names"]'); const ok = plainNone && /Name says abliterated: refusals cut out of the weights/.test(txt) && !!btn; return (ok ? 'OK' : 'FAIL') + ' | ' + cand.m.id + ' | ' + txt + ' | Qwen3-14B without line: ' + plainNone; })()

log: Help link: it opens the Help at 'Words in model names', which is in the Help's own list
js: (async () => { const btn = document.querySelector('#detail .ov-help'); if (!btn) return 'FAIL | no Help link'; btn.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); const d = $('dlgHelp'), body = d.querySelector('.dlg-body'), h = document.getElementById('help-names'); const want = h.offsetTop - body.offsetTop - 8, maxTop = body.scrollHeight - body.clientHeight; const atIt = Math.abs(body.scrollTop - Math.min(want, maxTop)) <= 2; const nav = !!d.querySelector('.help-nav [data-helpsec="help-names"]'); const navOn = (d.querySelector('.help-nav .on') || {}).textContent; const ok = d.open && atIt && nav && h.textContent === 'Words in model names'; return (ok ? 'OK' : 'FAIL') + ' | open: ' + d.open + ' | at the section: ' + atIt + ' (' + body.scrollTop + ' / ' + want + ') | in the list: ' + nav + ' | marked: ' + navOn; })()

log: Help search: 'abliterat' finds the rows in 'Words in model names' and the filter row
